rewritten_query: SELECT empno, MIN(EXPR1) FILTER (WHERE g_1), MIN(EXPR2) FILTER (WHERE g_1), MIN(EXPR3) FILTER (WHERE g_1), MIN(EXPR4) FILTER (WHERE g_1), MIN(EXPR5) FILTER (WHERE g_1), COUNT(sal) FILTER (WHERE g_0), CAST(MIN(EXPR7) FILTER (WHERE g_1) AS BIGINT) FROM (SELECT empno, deptno, sal, SUM(sal) AS EXPR1, MIN(sal) AS EXPR2, MAX(sal) AS EXPR3, BIT_AND(sal) AS EXPR4, BIT_OR(sal) AS EXPR5, GROUPING(deptno) AS EXPR7, GROUPING(empno, deptno, sal) = 0 AS g_0, GROUPING(empno, deptno, sal) = 1 AS g_1         FROM emp         GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((empno, sal, deptno), (empno, deptno))) AS t1 GROUP BY empno, deptno;
